question.q: Complete the report: 'By the time the science fair opened on Friday, the volunteers ______ all the exhibition booths.'
question.exp: The booth arrangement was completed before another past event ('opened on Friday'), so the past perfect 'had arranged' fits the timeline.

question.q: Complete: 'Only after the results were checked ______ the team publish its findings.'
question.exp: When the restrictive expression 'Only after ...' begins a sentence referring to the past, the main clause uses inversion with 'did + subject + base verb'.
